result.summary: The interface contains several layout and content inconsistencies suggestive of a prototype or test environment.

issues.description: A '-100%' discount badge is visible, which likely represents placeholder or erroneous data.
issues.suggestion: Replace with valid promotional values from the backend.

issues.description: The 'Trattoria Piccolo' restaurant title is truncated, cutting off the last few letters.
issues.suggestion: Enable text wrapping or adjust the layout to accommodate longer string lengths.

issues.description: Generic vector graphics are used for food items instead of high-fidelity photography.
issues.suggestion: Implement actual merchant imagery to improve the professional appearance of the catalog.
